summary: Iteration 12 — Bulk Multi-Add backend + frontend-route verification. Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_bulk_add.py (6 tests). 5/6 PASSED, 1 FAILED — revealed a real integration bug. /api/capture returns {analysis, clean_image} correctly (~14s, clean_image bounded via compress_b64). /api/items accepts the exact bulk-add.tsx body (name, category, colour, fabric, pattern, season, condition, price, photo, style, sleeve_length, formality, tone), persists them scoped to user_testaura01, GET /api/items returns them with pairs_count. Frontend: /bulk-add route is registered (in _layout.tsx) and reachable at /bulk-add — renders 'ADD SEVERAL' header, 'Choose photos…' idle state, and bulk-back testID; no red screen or Unmatched Route. The 'Several' entry link (testID add-item-bulk) is present in the /add-item header and correctly labelled. Native photo picker cannot open in web preview (expected). CRITICAL FINDING: bulk-add.tsx sends `price: ''` (empty string) whenever the AI analysis omits estimated_value; server rejects with 422 float_parsing error, so those items silently fail (caught by the outer try/catch and shown as 'Couldn't add' in the UI grid). Any auto-tagged garment without an AI estimated_value will fail to save in bulk mode.

critical.issue: Rejects `price: ''` (empty string) with HTTP 422 float_parsing. bulk-add.tsx sends `price: a.estimated_value ? String(a.estimated_value) : ''` — so any AI-tagged item where estimated_value is missing/falsy will silently fail during bulk add (marked 'Couldn't add' in UI). Repro: POST /api/items {name:'X', category:'Tops', price:'', photo:'<b64>'} → 422 {detail:[{type:'float_parsing', loc:['body','price'], msg:'Input should be a valid number, unable to parse string as a number', input:''}]}. Impact: partial data loss in the flagship bulk flow — user picks 5 photos, AI omits price on 2, only 3 get saved with no clear reason surfaced.

minor.issue: bulk-add.tsx falls back `season: a.season || 'All season'` but the app-wide SEASONS enum uses 'All' (see /app/frontend/src/theme). Server accepts as free string, but the wardrobe season chip filter won't match 'All season' — items saved via bulk with missing AI season won't surface under any season chip.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend sends `price: ''` for items missing AI estimated_value; backend Pydantic Optional[float] rejects empty string with 422. Fix at frontend (send `null`/omit) OR backend (coerce empty to None via validator). See /app/frontend/app/bulk-add.tsx line 62.

action_items: FIX (choose one): (a) In /app/frontend/app/bulk-add.tsx line 62 change `price: a.estimated_value ? String(a.estimated_value) : ''` to `price: a.estimated_value ? Number(a.estimated_value) : null` (or omit the field when falsy); OR (b) In /app/backend/server.py ItemCreate, add a Pydantic validator that coerces '' → None for the price field. Frontend fix is cleaner and matches add-item.tsx behaviour (which already sends `price ? parseFloat(price) : null`).
FIX: In /app/frontend/app/bulk-add.tsx line 60 change season fallback `'All season'` to `'All'` so the value matches the SEASONS enum used elsewhere in the app.

Consider surfacing per-photo failure reasons in the bulk-add UI (currently catch-all shows generic 'Couldn't add'). Even a small tap-to-see-why affordance would help users trust the flow when a subset fails.
After fixing (a), re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_bulk_add.py — the empty-string-price test will pass, giving full 6/6 green.
critical_code_review_comments: bulk-add.tsx line 62 — schema mismatch: sending price as STRING and empty string when missing. add-item.tsx line 131 does this correctly (`price ? parseFloat(price) : null`). The two callers of POST /api/items are inconsistent.

bulk-add.tsx line 47 processes photos strictly sequentially. Fine for correctness but each iteration is ~14s (capture + items). 15 photos ≈ 3.5 minutes with no chance to cancel. Consider a small concurrency (e.g. `p-limit` 2-3) once the price bug is fixed.
bulk-add.tsx uses `busy` ref for re-entrancy but does NOT reset it if the user backs out while phase='processing' and remounts. Low priority — modal presentation makes remount unlikely.
server.py compress_b64 swallows all Pillow errors silently (line 636-637). Not a bulk-add regression but worth logging at WARN for future forensics — already noted in iteration_11.
bulk-add.tsx line 108 falls back season to 'All season'; app SEASONS is 'All'. Frontend contract inconsistency.

rca_of_issue: RCA: bulk-add.tsx (line 62) builds POST /api/items body with `price: a.estimated_value ? String(a.estimated_value) : ''`. The `else '' ` branch produces an empty string, but backend Pydantic model ItemCreate.price is Optional[float]. Pydantic v2 does NOT coerce '' → None for float — it raises `float_parsing` (422). The frontend loop wraps each item in try/catch and treats ANY error as a failed row, so users see 'Couldn't add' for silently-dropped items with no diagnostic. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/capture where AI returns analysis without estimated_value (common — see ANALYZE_SYSTEM prompt: 'estimated_value (integer estimate)' — model may omit or return null), (2) frontend builds body with price:'', (3) POST /api/items → 422. Mitigation options — Frontend (preferred, matches add-item.tsx): send `null` when falsy. Backend (defence-in-depth): Pydantic field_validator to coerce ''→None for price.
